label: For "Spare Parts Criticality Classification": Classify spare parts by the downtime cost of being out of stock and by failure likelihood, so stocking policy covers critical parts at the right level. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Classifying by spend alone.
